verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing says it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite and offers 'AI-powered automations to close your books faster,' which is a first-party AI-for-close capability tied to accounting sync. However, nothing states that the AI assigns GL codes to transactions. The Categories API and the 'categorizing transactions' write action are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI auto-assigns GL codes/categories to transactions, support across multiple entities, details of how the mapping syncs to the ERP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI automatically assign GL codes to transactions across entities to accelerate close

citations.quote: Sync with Quickbooks, Xero or NetSuite, and save hours with AI-powered automations to close your books faster.
